听到动静，秦兰冷着脸没说话，自顾自玩手机。

没想到这小子蹬鼻子上脸，直接凑上来抱住她的胳膊。

“咋滴啦？谁惹俺姐生气？”

“呦，谁敢惹你生气？你现在可是大明星，一个顶俩。”

一番阴阳怪气，魏老板依旧嬉皮笑脸。

对待大姐姐他有经验，阴阳怪气没关系，只要让你进这个屋就还有救。

真要是生气，连屋子都不给你进！！

“行了，你少给我贫嘴。”

把手机放下，秦兰正了正神色：“昨天伯母给我打电话问你的情况，还问你有没有女朋友。”

我妈还问过这事儿...我怎么不知道？

这话一看就是炸他的，魏老板当然不能说实话：“没有。”

“真的吗？我不信。”

嘿.......你怎么说着鲁玉的话？

下午录节目没听到，没想到晚上听到。

“我现在只想搞事业，其他免谈。”

“好，要不要姐给你介绍一个？”

秦兰嘴角微微翘起。

她现在的心情很复杂，好弟弟看她的眼神越来越不对。

应该是憋的！！

她承认自己的身材颜值是不错，但俩人年纪相差有点大，而且太熟。

心里那关过意不去。

最好的方式就是给他介绍对象，有对象就不会乱想。

“介绍？就你那个姐妹团？”

听闻此言，秦兰心底的怒火立刻燃烧起来：“姐妹团个大头鬼。我发现你是不是有恋姐倾向啊，就喜欢比你大的？”

她们几个年纪和我差不多，还没我好看。

放屁，我只喜欢漂亮的！！

又大又漂亮也不是不可以。

“行了，这事儿不用你操心，就咱这长相会缺女朋友？”

眼见话题聊不下去，魏沐又问：“陆川导演的那部电影拍完？”

“没有，剧组停工了。”

“什么情况？”

秦兰身子一软，整个人陷进沙发里，双手朝上一摊，做了个“空空如也”的手势

“没钱，导演现在到处借钱，还问我借。”

“我听你之前的话，没借。”

“你做得对，他那部电影都不一定回本。”

说实话，都不用他对付陆串太郎，以陆导演在电影方面的造诣，会自己把自己玩死。

拍完这部电影，秦兰暂时没有接戏。

自从去年《又见一帘幽梦》火了之后，她就像个连轴转的陀螺，一口气拍了好几部戏，根本没停过。

她伸出双手，用力揉了揉脸颊，然后疲惫地向后一仰，轻轻靠在沙发靠背上。

Hearing the commotion, Qin Lan said nothing with a cold face and just played with his mobile phone.

Unexpectedly, this kid turned his nose up and directly came up to hug her arm.

"What happened? Who made my sister angry?"

"Hey, who dares to make you angry? You are a big star now, one can match two others."

Despite all the yin and yang, Boss Wei still had a playful smile on his face.

He has experience in dealing with big sisters. It doesn't matter if he is weird or yin and yang, as long as he lets you into this room, he will be saved.

If you are really angry, I won't even let you in the house!!

"Okay, stop talking to me."

Putting down the phone, Qin Lan straightened his expression: "Yesterday, my aunt called me to ask about you and if you have a girlfriend."

My mother also asked about this...Why didn't I know?

These words were offensive to him at first glance. Of course, Boss Wei couldn't tell the truth: "No."

"Really? I don't believe it."

Hey...why are you saying what Lu Yu said?

I didn’t hear the program during the afternoon recording, but I didn’t expect to hear it at night.

"I just want to pursue my career now, nothing else can be discussed."

"Okay, would you like me to introduce you to someone?"

The corners of Qin Lan's mouth raised slightly.

Her mood is very complicated now, and her good brother looks at her more and more wrongly.

He should be holding it back!!

She admitted that she had a good figure and good looks, but the age difference between the two was a bit big and they were too familiar.

I can't let go of that feeling in my heart.

The best way is to introduce him to a partner. If he has a partner, he will not have random thoughts.

"Introduction? Is it your sister group?"

Hearing this, the anger in Qin Lan's heart immediately burned: "Sisters are so big-headed. I found out that you have a tendency to fall in love with your sister, do you like those who are older than you?"

They are about the same age as me, but not as good-looking as me.

Fart, I only like beautiful ones!!

It’s not impossible to be big and beautiful.

"Okay, you don't have to worry about this. With our looks, do we need a girlfriend?"

Seeing that the conversation could not continue, Wei Mu asked again: "Has the film directed by Lu Chuan been finished?"

"No, the crew has stopped working."

"What's going on?"

Qin Lan's body softened and he sank into the sofa. He spread his hands upward and made an "empty" gesture.

"I don't have any money. The director is borrowing money from everywhere now and even asks me to borrow it."

"I heard what you said before, I didn't borrow it."

"You did the right thing. His movie may not even pay for itself."

To be honest, there is no need for him to deal with Riku Kushitarou. With Director Lu's attainments in movies, he will kill himself.

After filming this movie, Qin Lan has not taken any roles for the time being.

Since "Another Dream" became a hit last year, she has been like a spinning top, filming several movies in one go and never stopped.

She stretched out her hands and rubbed her cheeks vigorously, then leaned back tiredly and leaned lightly on the back of the sofa.
